mapper.sql: id, provider, model_name, display_name, base_url, capabilities, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_model_entry ORDER BY provider, model_name
SELECT FROM t_model_entry WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY provider, model_name
SELECT FROM t_model_entry WHERE provider = #{provider} AND model_name = #{modelName} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM t_model_entry WHERE status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teapot_workspace_model g WHERE g.model_entry_id = t_model_entry.id AND g.workspace_id IN (#{workspaceId}, 0) ) ORDER BY provider, model_name
SELECT workspace_id FROM teapot_workspace_model WHERE model_entry_id = #{modelEntryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO teapot_workspace_model (workspace_id, model_entry_id, creator) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{modelEntryId}, #{creator})

INSERT INTO t_model_entry (provider, model_name, display_name, base_url, capabilities, status, created_by) VALUES (#{provider}, #{modelName}, #{displayName}, #{baseUrl}, #{capabilities}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
